source_scope: First-party project documentation, dated release notes and cited research. Review decisions are editorial, not reproduced performance evaluations. Original daily source-coverage failures remain in the edition archive.

candidates.name: InvokeAI
candidates.editorial_basis: Named image-generation editing and node-workflow application, not a synonym for diffusion models. The November 1, 2026 v6.14.3 patch adds editable vector Canvas layers and resume-download repair to existing software.
candidates.evidence_scope: First-party release notes and project repository checked; release features are publisher claims, not an independently measured fidelity result.
candidates.limitations: Compatibility depends on backends, platform and models. Repository licensing and distribution/model entitlements require separate review; not all usage should be described as unrestricted.
required_before_catalog_publication: Assign unused stable technology ID without replacing 300 archived records
Document supported model backends, deployment/hardware requirements and distribution licenses
Connect canonical source/profile, related concepts, comparison/search and offline manifest

candidates.name: GDPx
candidates.editorial_basis: Named domain-specific evaluation suite: an agent is assessed on longer tasks in interactive work environments. This is an evaluation artifact, not a foundation model or an observed safety incident.
candidates.evidence_scope: The publisher reports 11 equally weighted domains and scores averaged over three attempts. These are benchmark-publisher reports, not a third-party replication or an estimate of all real work.
candidates.limitations: Task selection, graders, tool-harness differences, task contamination, benchmark revisions and partial credit constrain generalization. Avoid interpreting a publisher leaderboard's 12% as a universally replicated model failure rate.
required_before_catalog_publication: Determine public task availability, evaluation reproducibility and usage license
Document version, task and grading specifications and dependence on agent harness
Link to existing evaluation/environment concepts; label all scores publisher-reported

primary_sources.title: GDPx publisher's benchmark methods and leaderboard

candidates.name: NVIDIA Auto Ontology
candidates.editorial_basis: Named Python software framework for a semantic ontology layer and natural-language structured-data querying; not a newly invented ontology concept.
candidates.evidence_scope: First-party README describes Next.js gateway, FastAPI Python 3.12+, PostgreSQL/pgvector and configurable NVIDIA NIM inference endpoints. Apache-2.0 covers project code with third-party terms separately. Canonical catalog entry records the first-party repository at source revision cdaf61e1bd0cf3820d11d72b43bb460816aebbd3, not an independently reproduced system benchmark.
candidates.limitations: No verified initial public-release date; API inference may incur usage costs. The FastAPI service is a trusted internal boundary and must not be directly exposed to public untrusted clients; no generated SQL accuracy benchmark was replicated.
required_before_catalog_publication: Record exact project version and stable official documentation URL
Verify runtime, connected-database authorization, endpoint and cost constraints, third-party notices
Add profile ID, canonical search/comparison, relationships, and a working detail route

primary_sources.title: Official project README and deployment cautions

candidates.name: Windmill
candidates.editorial_basis: Existing developer workflow and app platform. The November 2, 2026 v1.856.0 notes report that MCP access can accept tokens from an external OIDC issuer.
candidates.evidence_scope: GitHub v1.856.0 release and exact-tagged README/LICENSE checked November 3; external OIDC MCP functionality is first-party documented but not independently penetration-tested or benchmarked.
candidates.limitations: Exact tagged license distinguishes AGPL and Apache source, proprietary Community Edition distribution, and commercial or managed-service limitations. The existing product is newly cataloged, not newly launched. Role mapping and worker isolation must be validated in deployment.
required_before_catalog_publication: Verify feature/version compatibility and minimum environment requirements
Document edition-specific license and deployment restrictions
Assign distinct technology ID with source, links, search, comparison and stable route

candidates.name: Agent harness
candidates.editorial_basis: An execution-and-observation scaffold surrounding an agent model, including tool interfaces, allowed actions, state, retries, telemetry and termination rules. Distinct in emphasis from a full agentic workflow and from model weights.
candidates.evidence_scope: Terminology is grounded in agent-runner documentation; the source does not establish a universally fixed architecture.
candidates.limitations: Tool permissions and prompting are implementation-specific. Evaluation must hold task/model constant when contrasting harness variants, and cannot attribute all gains to the model itself.
required_before_catalog_publication: Choose a precise definition and aliases without claiming an industry standard
Make boundaries with Agentic workflow, Tool use and Agent evaluation explicit
Add sourced example, security implications, stable ID, graph links and search

candidates.name: Semantic ontology layer
candidates.editorial_basis: A curated semantic/governance layer specifying entities, relationships, metric meaning, access constraints and lineage for agent or analytics queries. Broader than a bare knowledge-graph representation and different from nearest-neighbor semantic search.
candidates.evidence_scope: Grounded in one software implementation and adjacent ontology practice; the exact composite phrase is descriptive rather than established as a universally defined scientific standard.
candidates.limitations: A schema or ontology is neither evidence of correct input data nor authorization to query all linked systems; guard against treating retrieved context as trustworthy instructions.
required_before_catalog_publication: Source at least one independent terminology reference before canonization
Specify how the concept differs from Knowledge graph, semantic search and RAG
Publish canonical definition, applied example, stable ID and connected detail/search pages

candidates.name: Environment-grounded agent benchmark
candidates.editorial_basis: Describes benchmarking agent behavior against interactive environment state and task outcomes. It presently combines already indexed Benchmark, Environment and Agent evaluation rather than identifying a novel independent mechanism.
candidates.evidence_scope: Primary AgentBench, OSWorld and SWE-bench papers demonstrate interactive or environment-based evaluation, not standardization of this exact phrase.
candidates.limitations: Evaluations differ in task construction, graders, interaction limits and contamination sensitivity. Do not count a new term or assert independently reproduced scores.
required_before_catalog_publication: Keep as a related search phrase or description only after verifying index alias behavior
Only reconsider a new stable term ID if independent usage and a genuinely distinct mechanism are established
Preserve exact constituent concept IDs and evidence boundaries
